 Philadelphia looks to get back in the win column after a 106-93 loss to the Detroit Pistons on Sunday. Tyrese Maxey scored 29 points with five rebounds and four assists, shooting 11-for-24 from the field, while LeBron James added 18 points and five assists. Jaylen Brown added 16 points, and Adem Bona grabbed 13 rebounds and blocked three shots. The 76ers struggled early offensively, managing just 22 points in each of the first two quarters and shooting 42.0% from the field.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Indiana is coming off a 110-102 loss to the Milwaukee Bucks on Monday, despite strong games from Tyrese Haliburton and Pascal Siakam. Haliburton led the Pacers with 22 points, nine assists and six rebounds, making four three-pointers, while Siakam recorded 20 points, 13 rebounds and six assists. Obi Toppin scored 14 points off the bench, and Aaron Nesmith added 13. The Pacers had a 61-50 lead at halftime but were outscored 60-41 over the final two quarters, including a 26-17 fourth period.
